name: Tianjin Construction Development Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianjin Construction Development Group Co., Ltd. engages in the civil engineering construction business in Tianjin. The company provides municipal public construction works, such as road construction and traffic facilities construction; foundation works, including foundation construction and earthworks; building construction related works comprise building renovation, decoration, and intelligent building construction; and petrochemical engineering works, such as filling station upgrading and renovation, pipe installation, and oil tank overhaul projects. It also offers property rental services; sells construction materials; software equipped with multiple functions including cost monitoring, …
